parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence or facility ban is documented, and a 2023 poll found majority support for equal LGBTIQ+ rights, but a May 2026 police raid detained ~30 people at an LGBTQ+ venue, allegedly warrantless, extortionate and under a baseless 'homosexuality' charge. No hate-crime or gender-identity anti-discrimination recourse, working document remedy, or documented prosecution/discipline is shown. That is state-implicated targeting with thin recourse, offset by social acceptance and lawful same-sex conduct, placing it in Elevated Risk.

entry_documents.interaction: Resident identity-card procedure announced 2016 has no mechanism; per rules this does not itself penalise a visitor with home passport.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: May 2026 raid detained ~30 people at LGBTQ+ venue; allegedly warrantless entry, extortion, baseless charge; custody placement not documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Police as alleged perpetrators undermines recourse; no documented discipline or release outcome.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No birth-sex bathroom, ward or facility rule documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: No regional variation documented beyond the single-state raid; extrapolation beyond it is unevidenced.

care_services.exposure: No trans-specific care denial or medication confiscation documented; general transition provisions absent is resident-facing.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Police allegedly framed homosexuality as a crime despite no criminalisation; post-2024 election persecution reported for LGBTQ+ people.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Same-sex conduct not criminalised, age of consent equal at 16.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Lawful status coexists with enforcement practice contrary to law; no working gender-recognition route is resident-facing climate only.

minors_guardians.protection: 2016 court ruling protected children of same-sex families in civil registration; lesbian IVF access noted.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident family rules do not establish visitor-facing minor protection or risk.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No hate-crime statute or gender-identity anti-discrimination law, so no dedicated penalty/aggravation; no trans-specific violence rate documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: 2023 poll: majority support equal rights for LGBTIQ+ population.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Social acceptance mitigates street hostility, but absence of dedicated recourse leaves police-perpetrated raid unremedied.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No documented remedy, prosecution, compensation or discipline after 2026 raid; subnational breakdown absent.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Legislature passed 17 May resolution 2016 but supreme court suspended it; Pride participation noted.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Thin data extrapolated from police impunity, no recourse framework and post-election persecution, not toward midpoint safety.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar police extortion and baseless suspicion, but 0.35-C documents routine repeated stops of foreign travellers; here only one raid of ~30 is documented, no routine pattern or birth-sex custody, so higher.

Similar absence of universal ban and some acceptance, but 0.55-B has mediators securing readmissions/refunds and a police conviction; here no remedy or conviction is documented and police are alleged perpetrators, so lower.

0.75-C has dead-letter sexuality law, traditional acceptance and enforced court compensation; here acceptance is poll-based, sexuality law is not criminalised, but there is no enforced compensation and a recent police raid, so materially lower.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national law does not criminalise same-sex conduct or trans presentation and public majority support equality, with no documented facility, border or care exclusion. Against that, the only located enforcement is a state-implicated 2026 venue raid with extortion and false charge, and no hate-crime, anti-discrimination or documented corrective mechanism exists. Minors/families have no documented visitor-facing exposure. The documented worst feature is tier-2 police targeting with thin recourse, tempered by single-incident frequency and social acceptance, yielding mid-Elevated Risk.
